    AI Overview
    Hofstra University is located in Hempstead, New York, on Long Island. The campus is situated about 25 miles east of Manhattan, making it accessible to New York City while providing a suburban, 240-acre campus environment. The main address is 900 Fulton Avenue, Hempstead, NY 11550. 
    Key Details About Location: 
    • Proximity to NYC: Roughly 25 miles from Manhattan.
    • Setting: Suburban Long Island in the town of Hempstead.
    • Campus Type: A 240-acre accredited arboretum.
    • Accessibility: Located near the Meadowbrook Parkway and Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum. 
    Hofstra is a private university known for its suburban campus atmosphere while maintaining close ties to the opportunities available in New York City.

    Is Hofstra considered Ivy League?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    No,
    Hofstra University is not an Ivy League school    . It is a private university in Hempstead, New York, with a 68.1% acceptance rate (as of PrepScholar), ranking it as moderately selective rather than the ultra-competitive, historic athletic conference known as the Ivy League, notes PrepScholar and Career Karma. 
    Key details about Hofstra's standing: 
    • Ranking: Hofstra is ranked #183 in National Universities in the 2026 U.S. News & World Report edition, say U.S. News & World Report.
    • Athletic Conference: Hofstra competes in the Coastal Athletic Association (CAA), not the Ivy League, according to Hofstra University Athletics.
    • Ivy League Members: The true Ivy League schools are Brown, Columbia, Cornell, Dartmouth, Harvard, Princeton, University of Pennsylvania, and Yale, notes
      The Hofstra Chronicle and Wikipedia.
       
    While Hofstra is not in the Ivy League, it is a well-regarded private institution, specifically noted for having a strong, top-tier ranked law school and medical school, say U.S. News & World Report.

      Description

      Hofstra University is a private research university in Hempstead, New York, United States. It originated in 1935 as an extension of New York University and became an independent college in 1939. Wikipedia
      Address: 1000 Hempstead Tpke, Hempstead, NY 11549
      Acceptance rate: 68.1% (2024) IPEDS
      Undergraduate tuition and fees: 55,450 USD (2023 – 24) IPEDS
      Campus: Large suburb, 244 acres (99 ha)
      Mascot: Willie Pride, Kate Pride
      Students: 10,685 (2025)
      Typical SAT scores: Reading and Writing 620-700, Math 610-700 (2023–24) IPEDS
      Application fee: a $70 hofstra.edu
      Colors: Blue, white, and gold;
      President: Susan Poser
      Provost: Charles Riordan
      Established: September 23, 1935; 90 years ago
      Endowment: $955.8 million (2025)
      Phone: (516) 463-6600
